claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: BADGE is a low-affinity PPARgamma ligand (Kd ~100 uM) with no PPARgamma-independent cytotoxic mechanism reported at 2.5 uM; it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
